newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI has chosen designs for planned Euro banknotes.
newsitem.headline: EMI has chosen designs for planned Euro banknotes.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute, forerunner to the planned European Central Bank, said on Tuesday that its policy-making council has selected the draft designs for the planned single European currency.

The Frankfurt-based EMI said the designs for the seven denominations in the Euro banknote series - EURO 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 and 500 - will be presented to European leaders at a European Council meeting in Dublin on December 13.

The EMI said the decision was part of preparations for Stage Three of European monetary union and will ensure that the Euro banknotes can be put into circulation toward the end of 2001 in accordance with the European Council's plans.

A press conference will be held following the meeting on December 13 at 1400 GMT at the Central Bank of Ireland. A news conference will be held at the same time at the EMI headquarters in Frankfurt, the EMI said.
